description: Resolve an ongoing incident, marking it as handled/closed. Idempotent-ish: resolving an already-resolved incident returns HTTP 409. Uptime API: POST /api/v3/incidents/{id}/resolve.

incident_id.description: The incident id to resolve (from list_incidents).

resolved_by.description: User e-mail or a custom identifier of who is resolving the incident.

name: resolve_incident
title: Resolve an incident
